title: Mystery Graphics
content: Here's a montage of sticker graphics that I photographed on an outside wall a couple years ago. Who can guess where I took the picture?The first person who names the correct town or city in the comments wins two free signed and remarqued posters. (The two-sided posters forImaginative RealismandColor and Light).One guess per person, please.-----Addendum: Michael has guessed the correct answer: Laguna Beach, California.
